security.evidence: Webhook URL kept out of failure logs: status-only context (:94) and exception class + message with str_replace($url, '[webhook-url]', ...) (:98-101); sensitive keys and Bearer values redacted recursively (:123-137), Bearer also scrubbed from title/message (:110,153-156). Minor gap: the scrub only replaces the exact URL string, so URL-encoded or partially quoted variants in exception messages would still leak; Stringable objects in context bypass the Bearer check.

scope.evidence: All files serve the task: notifier, services/logging config, .env.example, phpunit.xml, docs/ops/logging.md, a cross-link in docs/ops/devops.md, CHANGELOG and tests. Notifier is not wired into any job/handler (out of scope respected).

issues.explanation: The diff never touches the daily channel, so 14-day retention via LOG_DAILY_DAYS depends on the existing config; it is only asserted by LoggingChannelsTest.php:473-477, not shown being set.
URL scrubbing is an exact str_replace, so an exception message containing the webhook URL in encoded or altered form (or just the token path) would still be logged.
When LOG_STACK was unset, the finally block restores it as 'LOG_STACK=' and assigns false into $_ENV/$_SERVER instead of unsetting it again.
The Bearer check applies only to string values; a Stringable object containing a bearer token would be rendered unredacted by render().

review.summary: Adds App\Ops\DiscordOpsAlert (no-op when unconfigured, JSON content POST with timeout, key/bearer/nested redaction, 1800-char multibyte truncation, soft-fail logging with the URL scrubbed), the audit log channel, daily as the default stack, env/phpunit/docs/CHANGELOG updates, and thorough Pest tests. The work is lean, well documented and covers the contract; only minor gaps remain (daily retention not visibly set in the diff, exact-string URL scrubbing), so it is approvable with nits.
